requirement.description: RLP encoding implementation has incorrect handling of integer encoding and various edge cases, causing test failures. The rlp_encode function doesn't correctly handle all data types and produces incorrect encodings for integers and lists.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to properly encode integers, strings, and lists according to the RLP specification. The function should produce correct hexadecimal encodings that match expected test outputs. Specifically, fix the integer encoding for values like 0, 15, 1024, etc.

requirement.description: Missing cryptographic dependencies for signature-related functions. The ecdsa and hashlib packages are required but not properly installed or imported in the environment, causing import errors when running signature tests.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the cryptographic functions (private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key) properly handle missing dependencies with clear error messages, and that the implementation correctly handles the signature algorithms according to Ethereum standards.

requirement.description: CREATE2 address computation fails due to incorrect keccak hashing implementation and improper handling of hex data conversion. The function throws ValueError for non-hexadecimal numbers when processing inputs.
requirement.contract: Fix the get_created_address function to properly handle CREATE2 address calculations by correctly converting hex data and computing keccak hashes. The function should handle invalid inputs gracefully and produce correct Ethereum addresses.

requirement.description: RLP decoding functions lack proper fallback mechanisms when the rlp package is not available, and have issues with handling certain data types.
requirement.contract: Improve the rlp_decode function to handle all supported data types (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex) properly even when the rlp package is not installed. Fix the decoding logic to correctly process all test cases.

requirement.description: Missing or incomplete format conversion utilities that are used throughout the binary module but not properly implemented in the codebase.
requirement.contract: Ensure that all format conversion functions (convert, get_binary_format) are properly implemented and accessible. These are used in several places but appear to be missing from the codebase.
